# Landing Page Build Prompt — Vetric Style (Fictional Brand)

## 1. Architecture & Rules (Mandatory)

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- All styling must live in a dedicated `style.css`. No `style="..."` attributes in HTML. Target all design via class/ID selectors only. Keep HTML semantic, clean, and styling-agnostic.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define all tokens in `:root` (light theme default, dark mode overrides under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark`):
- Colors: `--color-midnight-ink: #090a1e`, `--color-paper-white: #ffffff`, `--color-ash-border: #e0e0e0`, `--color-carbon-nav: #222222`, `--color-mist-blue: #c3dae3`, `--color-pure-black: #000000`, `--color-prism-blue: #2969ff`, `--color-prism-pink: #f75cc3`, `--color-prism-yellow: #ffd363`, `--color-prism-green: #5ab040`, `--color-cream-wash: #fffdea`, `--color-mint-wash: #eaffed`, `--color-blush-wash: #fff3fb`, `--color-sky-wash: #e5f5ff`, `--color-prism-gradient: linear-gradient(90deg, #f75cc3, #2969ff, #ffd363, #5ab040)`.
- Contrast pairing: light backgrounds pair with dark text (Midnight Ink), dark backgrounds pair with Paper White.
- Backgrounds: do not use pure white where a tinted surface is specified; use `#fefefe` only if a near-white is needed.
- Radius & shadows: `--radius-sm: 7px`, `--radius-md: 7px`, `--radius-lg: 24.5px`. No drop shadows — flatness is intentional.
- Spacing & transitions: `--spacing-4: 4px`, `--spacing-28: 28px`, `--spacing-44: 44px`, `--spacing-48: 48px`, `--spacing-56: 56px`, `--spacing-88: 88px`, `--spacing-gap: 14px`, `--transition-fast`, `--transition-normal`, `--ease-standard`.
- Elevation/stacking: `--z-dropdown`, `--z-modal`, `--z-toast`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode**
Provide dark mode tokens under `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and `.dark`. Background and text variables switch seamlessly. Persist user choice via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme`. Include a visible toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label`.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First**
Use Flexbox for all layouts. Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless explicitly justified. Mobile-responsive out of the box (rows collapse to columns), no horizontal scrolling.

**1.5 Framework**
Use Tailwind CSS (or clean custom CSS driven by Tailwind `@layer`/`@apply`). Utility classes must map to CSS variables or reusable class names (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`).

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- Text: Google Fonts — Noto Serif (400, 500) for headlines, Manrope (400, 500, 600, 700) for UI/body. Bind to `--font-noto-serif` and `--font-manrope`. Include `<link>`/`@import`.
- Icons: Google Material Symbols/Icons only. No inline SVGs or local icon files.

## 2. Component Specifications

**2.1 Buttons**
- Primary CTA: `#090a1e` bg, `#ffffff` text, Manrope 14–16px weight 500, padding 11px 28px, radius 7px, no border. Flex layout, min 44x44px touch target. States: hover (brightness/shadow + cursor pointer), focus (ring via CSS vars), active (scale 0.97), loading (spinner, disabled), disabled (opacity 0.5, greyscale, not-allowed), success/error (temporary feedback).
- Ghost Secondary: transparent bg, 1px border `#090a1e` or `#e0e0e0`, text `#090a1e`, same padding/radius/font. Same state coverage.
- No fully rounded (9999px) buttons; 7px radius is deliberate.

**2.2 Cards**
- Feature Card (Compact): `#ffffff` bg, 1px border `#e0e0e0`, radius 7px, padding 18–25px. Monochrome outline icon top-left (20–24px), title Noto Serif/Manrope 19–23px, body Manrope 14–16px, 3-bullet list. 2-column grid.
- Tinted Pastel Card: one of `#fffdea`/`#eaffed`/`#fff3fb`/`#e5f5ff` bg, 1px border tinted to matching prism hue, radius 7–24.5px, padding 25–28px.
- States: hover (elevation/shadow shift or translateY(-2px)), focus-within (highlight border), loading (shimmer skeleton), empty state (Google Icon + guidance text).

**2.3 Forms & Inputs**
- States: empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border/icon), invalid (error border, red text, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- Structure: flex container with label, input, dedicated error feedback container.

**2.4 Modals/Popups**
- States: opening, open, loading, success/error, closing (CSS transitions).
- Centered flex container, backdrop overlay, Google Icon close button, focus trapping, close via Esc or overlay click.

## 3. Core UX & Micro-Interactions
- Responsive by default, fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow.
- CSS transitions on all state changes (`transition: var(--transition-normal)`), respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
- Accessibility: sufficient contrast in both modes; never rely solely on color; semantic HTML5; correct ARIA roles/labels; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` for dynamic feedback.
- Mandatory visual feedback on every click/hover/submission.
- Destructive actions visually distinct in both themes.

## 4. Deliverables
- Separate `index.html`, `style.css`, `script.js`. No inline `<script>` beyond a single deferred entry-point reference.
- Consistent class-naming convention (BEM or fixed utility set) throughout — never mix.
- No lorem-ipsum-only submissions where real copy/labels are supplied; placeholders only where content genuinely unspecified.

## 5. Edit Mode — N/A (from-scratch build)

## 6. Content & Branding Rules
- **Invent a fictional brand name, product, and copy.** Never use the real brand name "Vetric", its logo, trademarks, or product names anywhere in the page. The visual style (colors, typography, spacing, radii, flatness, prism gradient) is reused; the identity is original.
- All user-facing copy must be in English.

## 7. Page Structure — Landing Page
Build a complete landing page with these sections in order:
1. **Top Navigation Bar** — white bg, 1px bottom border, 64–72px tall. Logo (blue diamond + fictional wordmark) left, 4–5 text links (Products ▾, Use Cases, About, Careers) right, Manrope 14–16px weight 500 Midnight Ink. No fill, no shadow.
2. **Hero (Prism Hero)** — centered on `#ffffff`: Noto Serif 77px display headline (Midnight Ink, -0.05em), 18px Manrope subtext, CTA pair (Primary + Ghost), and a large iridescent glass-diamond/prism graphic bleeding pink/blue/yellow/green into white. The prism is the only hero artwork.
3. **Logo Strip** — horizontal row of monochrome/light-tinted wordmarks at uniform height (~24px), 35–42px gaps, muted gray (`#222` or `#e0e0e0`), never full color. Eyebrow label "TRUSTED BY" above (Manrope 11px weight 500, 0.06em tracking, all-caps).
4. **Features (3 cards)** — "We Do the Heavy Lifting" section with eyebrow kicker. Three Feature Cards (Compact) in 2-column grid (third wraps). Each: monochrome icon, title, body, 3-bullet list.
5. **How It Works (3 steps)** — Borderless Feature Rows: icon above, Noto Serif 26–35px title, Manrope 16–18px body. Three steps in a row (collapse to column on mobile).
6. **Comparison Split Section** — two-column problem vs. solution. Left on `#ffffff` with scattered chaotic Pill/Tag Chips (floating, overlapping). Right on full-bleed iridescent gradient (pink → blue → yellow → green) with white-tinted supporting text.
7. **Tinted Pastel Cards** — 3–4 accent-keyed cards using pastel washes keyed to prism colors (cream/mint/blush/sky), radius 7–24.5px.
8. **Testimonials** — cards on white with 1px borders, no shadows.
9. **Pricing (3 tiers)** — three cards: one highlighted (Midnight Ink fill or prism border), two standard. Include feature lists and CTAs.
10. **FAQ** — accordion-style, keyboard accessible, `aria-expanded`.
11. **Final CTA** — Prism Gradient Banner background (full-width gradient with feathered edges), centered headline + subtext + CTA.
12. **Footer** — secondary links in columns, muted gray text, no shadow.

## 8. Style Constraints (Do/Don't)
- Do: Noto Serif 49–77px for primary headlines paired with Manrope 16–19px body; pull accent color only from the four-color prism set; apply iridescent gradient only as full-bleed section wash or behind a single large graphic (never button fill or card bg); use pastel wash surfaces keyed to matching prism color; eyebrows at 11px Manrope weight 500, 0.06em tracking, all-caps; `#090a1e` for text and filled CTA; separate surfaces with 1px borders `#e0e0e0` or `#c3dae3`; never drop shadows.
- Don't: no drop shadows/glows/elevation; no 9999px radius buttons; icons in no more than one color at a time, never multicolor filled sets; no body text directly on iridescent gradient without white scrim; no new accent hue; no Noto Serif for body/UI; no pure `#000000` for body text.

## 9. Imagery & Layout
- Minimal abstract imagery. Hero uses single iridescent glass-diamond/prism graphic (faceted, translucent, throwing pink/blue/yellow/green refraction). Supporting sections use full-bleed pastel gradient washes with feathered edges. No photography of people/offices/devices. Icons flat single-weight outlines in Midnight Ink or a single prism accent. Max-width 1200px centered container, generous horizontal padding. Sections stack vertically with 80px+ gaps, no alternating background bands — everything on white except discrete gradient panels/card tints. Feature grids 2-column. Comparison section full-bleed split. Single minimal top bar, no sidebar/mega-menu. Long editorial scroll, not a dashboard.
